comment-rr-delay.label: Comment removal reason delay
comment-rr-delay.helpText: Amount of time (in seconds) the app should wait after a removal reason is added to a comment so that a mod-distinguished reply can post.

enable-post-lock.label: Lock removed posts
enable-post-lock.helpText: If enabled, posts will be locked automatically when they are removed.

enable-lock-deleted.label: Lock deleted posts
enable-lock-deleted.helpText: If enabled, posts will be locked automatically when they are deleted by the Original Poster.

enable-post-unlock.label: Unlock approved posts
enable-post-unlock.helpText: If enabled, posts will be unlocked automatically when they are approved. Follows same Mod Settings below.

mod-settings.label: Mod Settings
mod-settings.helpText: Please omit any leading "u/" in the below settings (e.g., removed-posts, not u/removed-posts) or leave blank to disable.

ignore-ureddit.label: Ignore posts filtered by Reddit
ignore-ureddit.helpText: If enabled, posts filtered, removed, or approved by u/reddit will not be locked/unlocked.

ignore-automod.label: Ignore posts actioned by AutoModerator
ignore-automod.helpText: If enabled, posts filtered, removed, or approved by AutoModerator will not be locked/unlocked.

ignore-admins.label: Ignore posts actioned by Admins
ignore-admins.helpText: If enabled, posts removed or approved by Reddit Admins will not be locked/unlocked.

mod-blacklist.label: Mod blocklist
mod-blacklist.helpText: Comma (,) separated list of moderator usernames. Posts removed/approved by these mods will be ignored. This setting is ignored if the allowlist is not empty.

mod-whitelist.label: Mod allowlist
mod-whitelist.helpText: Comma (,) separated list of moderator usernames. Only posts removed/approved by these mods will be locked/unlocked. Overrides the blocklist above.

nuke-comments.label: Remove all comments on spam posts (CAUTION ADVISED)
nuke-comments.helpText: If enabled, posts that are marked as spam will have all their comments removed, except for pinned comments and top-level distinguished mod comments. Only works if post locking is also enabled. This action is NOT easily reversible for posts with many comments; caution is advised.

lock-comments-on-rr.label: Lock removed comments when a removal reason and mod reply are added
lock-comments-on-rr.helpText: If enabled, when a removal reason is added to a removed comment, after a very brief delay, the app will check if that comment has a mod-distinguished reply. If it does, it will lock the removed comment. This prevents users from being able to reply to their own removed comments to get around locked mod replies.
